corrections.text: The article states the India 8GB/256GB Phone (4b) is priced at "₹38,999... according to Beebom." Beebom's cited page does not contain this figure; it lists only a single 8GB/128GB India SKU at ₹34,999. The ₹38,999 8GB/256GB India price is correct and is reported by TechCabal, not Beebom.
